_instructions: Shell geometry for the new UI. The view type is declared by whatever mounts the chat: the desktop column passes 'desktop', the chat page passes 'mobile', an embed passes 'widget'; it is never inferred from width alone. common is the base and the active profile overlays it: objects merge, arrays replace, null inherits. narrow_follows_mobile decides whether that profile hands a narrow window to the mobile profile (desktop false keeps the column at any width; widget is always false).
